instructions.question: Which budget category does the bank transaction in `transaction` belong to?
instructions.context: `transaction` is one line from a Canadian household's bank or credit-card statement (CAD). Names, account numbers and bank names were removed and may appear as 'a person' or 'bank'.

Transfers.includes: Money moved between the household's own accounts or to and from people, not paid to a business: e-Transfers sent to or received from a person, moving money between chequing and savings, paying the credit-card bill from the bank account, and ATM cash withdrawals.
Transfers.excludes: Loan or line-of-credit repayments (Debt Payments); buying investments or crypto (Savings & Investing); paying any business for goods or services

Debt Payments.includes: Repaying borrowed money: line-of-credit repayments, personal and instalment loans, car loans, student loans (NSLSC), buy-now-pay-later plans such as Affirm, and lines worded 'Online bill payment for <card or loan>'.
Debt Payments.excludes: Lines worded 'Bill Payment - <card>' or 'Credit Card Payment' (Transfers > Credit-Card Payment); mortgage or rent (Housing); moving money to your own savings (Transfers)

Income.includes: Money coming in that the household earned or got back: salary and payroll deposits, freelance or contract payments, interest earned, dividends, cashback rewards, merchant refunds, and proceeds from selling crypto.
Income.excludes: Money moved in from the household's own savings or other accounts (Transfers)

Savings & Investing.includes: Putting money into investments: buying crypto, contributing to a brokerage, TFSA or RRSP account, and investment gains or interest kept inside an investment account.
Savings & Investing.excludes: Plain moves to a savings account (Transfers > To Savings); cashback (Income)

Dining & Take-out.includes: Food and drink prepared by someone else: coffee shops, fast-food chains, sit-down restaurants, food-delivery apps, bars, breweries and liquor stores.
Dining & Take-out.excludes: Supermarkets and grocery stores (Groceries); Uber rides (Transportation)

Groceries.includes: Food and household staples bought to use at home, at supermarkets, warehouse clubs and grocery chains.

Entertainment & Recreation.includes: Fun, media and leisure: streaming services, video games, movies, golf and live events, hobbies and crafts, and app or software subscriptions.
Entertainment & Recreation.excludes: Gyms and fitness (Personal Care); flights and hotels (Travel & Vacation); mobile phone and internet bills (Utilities)

Shopping.includes: Buying goods: online retail, clothing and shoes, electronics, toys, gifts and plants, and general or convenience stores including vape shops.
Shopping.excludes: Groceries; pharmacy (Healthcare); furniture and hardware for the home (Housing)

Transportation.includes: Getting around: gas stations, public transit and PRESTO, rideshare and taxis, parking and toll highways, car and truck rental, and car repairs.
Transportation.excludes: Flights and hotels (Travel & Vacation); auto insurance (Insurance); Uber Eats (Dining & Take-out)

Utilities.includes: Monthly household services: mobile phone and top-ups, home internet, natural gas, heating and water-heater rentals, hydro and water.

Personal Care.includes: Looking after yourself: gym memberships, fitness programs and classes, hair and barber, cosmetics and skincare, spa and massage.

Miscellaneous Fees.includes: Bank fees and charges, overdraft fees and interest, payment-service fees, charitable donations, lottery tickets, postage and office supplies.

Insurance.includes: Insurance premiums: auto, home or tenant, and life.

Education & Self-Improvement.includes: Learning: online courses and certificates, tuition, books and e-books, learning apps.
Education & Self-Improvement.excludes: School supplies or uniforms for children (Child & Dependent Care)

Healthcare.includes: Medical care: pharmacies, prescriptions and online pharmacies, doctor, lab and dentist visits, medical devices.

Housing.includes: The home itself: rent or mortgage, condo fees, home repairs and maintenance, and furniture.

Travel & Vacation.includes: Trips away from home: flights, hotels, Airbnb and other lodging.

Shipping.includes: Paying a courier or freight company to deliver a package.

Child & Dependent Care.includes: Costs for children or dependants: daycare, school supplies and school uniforms.
